scope: common scalar temporal-centroid comparator on frozen 7x5 low-k response block

coordinate.definition: z_R=exp(sum_z q_z ln(1+z))-1; q_z=sum_k r(k,z)^2/sum_zk r(k,z)^2

hard_interpretation: A model-independent common scalar temporal coordinate exists, so E4 is not implementation-blocked. However no preregistered scalar separation threshold or observational covariance exists, and the nearest C1 centroid is close; z_R alone is not a defensible mechanism discriminator.
